key_path: Sign up at together.ai > Get Started using Google or GitHub OAuth (no email/password)
Add a payment method and buy at least $15 of credits (no free trial; fully prepaid)
Project > Settings > API keys > Create API Key (project-scoped, optional expiry)
export TOGETHER_API_KEY and call the OpenAI-compatible endpoint

agent_native_auth.cli_login_browser_or_device: no. The Together CLI and Together Link read TOGETHER_API_KEY
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: no documented key-mint API (only GET whoami to identify a key's project/org)
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: yes. Project-scoped keys, RBAC roles, expiration dates

mcp.one_click_install: Skills install via `npx skills add togethercomputer/skills`, the Claude Code plugin marketplace, a Cursor plugin manifest and a Gemini extension

docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes (.md); each page has a 'fetch llms.txt' agent header

score_justification: Great coding-agent docs (skills, docs MCP, OpenAPI), but a $15 card paywall before any call and no agent-native auth or product MCP.
best_practice: A 'Coding agent setup' page that ships skills and a docs MCP together, with install commands for every major agent.
biggest_gap: No free tier: a $15 prepaid card purchase is required before the first API call.
